product_overview: A web app for DIU students to discover campus food stalls, submit star ratings and text reviews, and for shop owners and admins to manage shops, menus, and replies. Supports email/password and Google OAuth authentication with role-based interfaces for students, shop owners, and admins.
core_goals: Allow students to discover shops, view menus, and submit 1–5 star reviews with textual comments.
Provide shop owners with dashboards to manage shops, menu items, view reviews, and reply to customers.
Give admins tools to approve/reject shop owner accounts, manage shops and users, and monitor platform KPIs.
Accurately compute and display shop average ratings and a leaderboard while enforcing one review per student per shop.
Secure authentication via Supabase (email/password + Google OAuth) and role-based route access controls.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate students or shop owners using email/password or Google OAuth and handle common errors.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button to submit -> See dashboard (authenticated) on success
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with invalid credentials -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button to submit -> See error toast on invalid credentials
Navigate to /login -> Click Sign in with Google for OAuth -> Browser redirects to OAuth provider -> Return to /auth/callback -> See dashboard or account confirmation state

features.name: User Signup
features.description: Register a new account as a Student or Shop Owner; shop owners may enter a pending approval state.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Click Student or Shop Owner role toggle button -> Fill full name input -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click Create Account button -> See success screen (student) or pending approval message (shop owner)

Navigate to /signup -> Click Shop Owner role toggle button -> Fill full name input -> Fill email input with already-registered email -> Fill password input -> Click Create Account button -> See error toast about existing account or validation error

features.name: Browse Shops
features.description: Students browse all active shops, view cards with average ratings and a small leaderboard preview, and navigate to shop details.
user_flows: Navigate to /shops -> See grid of shop cards with images and average rating -> Click shop card to view shop detail (/shops/[shopId])
Navigate to /shops while unauthenticated -> See prompt or redirect to /login -> Attempt to access /shops -> See authentication required message

features.name: View Shop Detail and Menu
features.description: Students view shop profile, menu items, reviews, submit a new review, or edit their existing review for that shop.
user_flows: Navigate to /shops/[shopId] -> View shop name, description, and image -> View average rating and review count -> Browse menu items with names, prices, descriptions -> Read reviews with reviewer names and ratings -> Submit new review with star rating and text body -> See new review displayed and updated average rating

Navigate to /shops/[shopId] -> Click Submit new review -> Fill star rating but leave review text empty if text is required -> Click Submit -> See validation error toast or inline error preventing submission
Navigate to /shops/[shopId] -> Click Edit on own existing review -> Modify rating and text -> Click Save -> See updated review displayed

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Students view shops ranked by average rating, with special styling for top ranks and links to shop pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /leaderboard -> View ranked shops with name, image, average rating, review count -> See rank badges for 1st/2nd/3rd -> Click a shop entry to open /shops/[shopId]
Navigate to /leaderboard when few shops exist -> See leaderboard with available shops and notice about minimum review threshold (if implemented)

features.name: My Reviews
features.description: Students view their review history, see owner replies, and edit reviews they've submitted.
user_flows: Navigate to /my-reviews -> View list of own reviews with shop name, rating, text, timestamp -> Click Edit on a review -> Update text/rating -> Click Save -> See updated review
Navigate to /my-reviews with no reviews -> See empty state with Browse shops link -> Click Browse shops -> Navigate to /shops

features.name: Owner Dashboard
features.description: Shop owners create their shop if none exists or view shop performance stats and recent reviews when a shop exists.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/dashboard -> If no shop exists fill shop name input -> Fill description input -> Fill image URL input -> Click Create Shop -> See created shop stats and link to owner pages

Navigate to /owner/dashboard as owner with pending status -> See /owner/pending page or message instructing to wait for admin approval -> Attempt to navigate to /owner/menu -> See access denied or redirect to /owner/pending

features.name: Menu Management
features.description: Shop owners add, edit, archive/restore, and delete menu items for their shop.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/menu -> Click Add Menu Item button -> Fill name, description, price, image URL fields -> Submit to create menu item -> See new menu item in list
Navigate to /owner/menu -> Click Edit icon on existing item -> Modify fields -> Click Save -> See updated item in list
Navigate to /owner/menu -> Click Archive/Restore on an item -> See item status toggled (Active/Archived) -> See status reflected in shop menu
Navigate to /owner/menu -> Click Delete icon on item -> Confirm in alert dialog -> See item removed from list

features.name: Reply to Reviews
features.description: Shop owners reply to customer reviews; replies are displayed on the review card.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/reviews -> View all reviews for own shop -> Click reply button on unanswered review -> Type reply text in text area -> Submit reply -> See own reply displayed on review card
Navigate to /owner/reviews -> Click reply button -> Leave reply text empty -> Click Submit -> See validation error preventing submit

features.name: Shop Settings
features.description: Shop owners edit their shop profile information like name, description, and image URL.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/shop -> View current shop name, description, image URL fields -> Edit fields -> Click Save Changes button -> See success toast notification and updated profile
Navigate to /owner/shop -> Enter invalid image URL or leave required field empty -> Click Save Changes -> See error toast or inline validation preventing save

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Admins view platform KPIs, recent activity, and navigate to admin sections for approvals, shops, and users.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> See KPI cards (total shops, users, reviews, pending approvals count) -> View recent reviews list and top 5 rated shops -> Click Approvals in sidebar to navigate to /admin/approvals
Navigate to /admin/dashboard as non-admin -> See access denied or redirect to login/appropriate dashboard

features.name: Approve or Reject Shop Owners
features.description: Admins review pending shop owner applications and approve or reject them with confirmation dialogs.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/approvals -> View list of pending shop owner accounts with name, email, DIU verification badge, joined date -> Click Approve button -> See success state and account becomes active
Navigate to /admin/approvals -> Click Reject button on applicant -> Confirm in dialog -> See applicant status set to suspended and removed from pending list

features.name: Admin Shop Management
features.description: Admins create, edit, toggle active status, and delete shops across the platform, assigning owners as needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/shops -> Click Create Shop button -> Fill name, description, owner dropdown, image URL -> Submit to create shop -> See new shop in table
Navigate to /admin/shops -> Click Edit on existing shop -> Modify fields -> Save -> See updated shop data reflected in table
Navigate to /admin/shops -> Toggle shop active status checkbox -> See shop active flag updated
Navigate to /admin/shops -> Click Delete and confirm -> See shop removed from table

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Admins view and change user account statuses (activate/suspend) and inspect profile metadata.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> View list of all user profiles with name, email, role, status and DIU verification badges -> Click Suspend on active user -> See user status change to suspended
Navigate to /admin/users -> Click Activate on suspended user -> See user status change to active

known_limitations.issue: Authentication uses Supabase so test login requires real credentials or seeded test data
known_limitations.impact: E2E tests may need mock auth or pre-seeded test accounts

known_limitations.issue: Google OAuth requires browser redirect - can't be fully automated in headless tests
known_limitations.impact: OAuth flow tests limited to verifying redirect occurs

known_limitations.issue: Image uploads are via URL input only - no file upload UI
known_limitations.impact: Image-related tests limited to URL validation

known_limitations.issue: One review per student per shop enforced by DB UNIQUE constraint
known_limitations.impact: Test must create fresh review per shop or update existing
